item.title: Add a Member Cluster via Direct Connection
item.description: This section describes how to add a member cluster via direct connection. Note Before being managed, a member cluster only needs to have Kubernetes installed; KubeSphere installation is not required. If KubeSphere is already installed, please migrate the data and uninstall KubeSphere before proceeding with management. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the host cluster.
